title: Dental Field Trainer - Birmingham
description: Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients. About the Role: We’re looking for a highly consultative Field Trainer in Birmingham to lead impactful, in-person training that accelerates early clinical success with Dandy’s digital dentistry solutions. This role is field-based, with up to 80% travel, and is focused on helping dental practices adopt intraoral scanning and digital workflows with confidence. You’ll serve as a trusted clinical advisor to dentists, practice managers, and operational leaders—helping teams adopt new technology, digital workflows, improve clinical performance, and accelerate early success. This role combines clinical training expertise with operational execution and post-training insight to deliver measurable value at the intersection of training, technology, and practice growth. Success in this role comes from your ability to earn clinical trust and turn that trust into action — helping practices move from curiosity to confidence. What You’ll Do: Training Delivery & Clinical Coaching Lead high-touch, in-person trainings to support dentists and staff in adopting intraoral scanning and digital workflows. Coach teams based on live observation, reinforcing best practices and adapting in real time to meet the practice’s goals and maturity level. Take ownership of each practice’s success, driving early case submission by removing blockers, reinforcing clinical urgency, and building confidence during and immediately after training. Clinical Advisory & Post-Training Analysis Partner with clinicians and practice leaders to reinforce scanning habits and support early adoption. Monitor outcomes in the first 30 days and surface targeted coaching opportunities to accelerate success. Share field insights to inform scalable resources, improve onboarding, and strengthen future trainings. Practice Readiness & Operational Alignment Assess readiness across clinical workflows, team structure, and equipment to proactively surface blockers or risks. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure the right resources, messaging, and tools are in place before training day. Customize training strategies based on practice size, complexity, and clinical goals. What We’re Looking For: Clinical Training Experience: 3+ years of experience delivering clinical training in digital dentistry or dental technology, with strong familiarity with intraoral scanning and digital workflows. Clinical Advisor : Skilled at earning confidence from clinicians and staff by connecting clinical value to real-world outcomes Travel Readiness: Willingness and enthusiasm to travel up to 80% to deliver in-practice training and support. Proximity to Travel Hubs: Located near a major airport or transport hub. Leadership Presence: Comfortable partnering with senior leaders, clinicians, and staff across roles to influence behavior and drive adoption. In-Person Agility : Comfortable operating independently in the field, adjusting plans in real-time based on practice dynamics and needs. Strong Communicator: Excellent presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to adjust tone and approach based on audience—whether working with hygienists or C-suite stakeholders. Customer-Centric Mindset: Passion for helping practices succeed, with a solutions-oriented approach to onboarding, training, and adoption. Req ID: J-825 For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work. Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics. title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (m/f/d), Rust – AI-first E-commerce Tech
description: Since 2018, we’ve become one of Google’s largest CSS Premium Partners, powering Shopping ads for 1,000+ customers across 20,000+ Merchant Centres in Europe. Fully self-funded, profitable and still expanding, we’re a strong and supportive team with a stable foundation. Now we’re looking for a new colleague who wants to be part of it for the long run: an engineer who gets a goal rather than a ticket, builds with AI as a natural part of the job, and takes ownership from idea to production. Why adstrong 100% remote: work from anywhere in the EU, with flexible hours and no weekend or night work. No process chaos: documentation and procedures are well-structured and digital. No politics: we encourage proactive decisions and make ours within 24 hours. Stable and growing: a fully self-funded, fast-growing company with no external investors. Small, skilled team: a hands-on tech team of around 6 people. Great working culture: supportive colleagues who help each other and share knowledge openly. AI-first: coding agents are how we build, and your judgement is what matters. Attractive compensation: plus all the equipment you need. Missing anything? Mention it in your application, and we’ll see if we can make it happen. What you will do Build AI-first: plan with AI, drive coding agents and review their output with a critical eye. Get a goal, not a ticket: work directly with colleagues on the business side to gather requirements, align on the solution and build it into working software. Make sound architecture and data-model decisions , keeping our systems fast and reliable as we scale. Take ownership of existing applications and build new solutions for our affiliate business. Design and develop event-driven backend systems that handle large volumes of product and campaign data, mostly in Rust and partly in Python. Own your topics end to end and keep the team and stakeholders in the loop along the way. What you bring Experience contributing to a strong engineering culture , e.g. through code reviews, knowledge sharing, or improving team tools and ways of working. Daily hands-on work with coding agents: you plan with AI, delegate the implementation and know how to review what comes back, including more complex workflows like one model writing code while another reviews it. Strong architectural awareness: you know which components and infrastructure to use for which problem, and how to structure what you build. Rust experience , or curiosity about it and readiness to make it your main language , as most of our backend is written in it. C or C++ experience is a strong alternative. Experience solving problems close to ours, ideally in e-commerce, affiliate marketing, Google Shopping, Google Ads or other data-heavy web platforms. Our business team will help you build the domain knowledge. Experience with event-driven systems (e.g. Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS or similar) A solid grasp of the full engineering process : requirements, design, trade-offs, testing and maintainability Mid- or senior-level experience. We care more about how you think and work than about years on paper. Our business team will help you build the domain knowledge. A Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field. Business-fluent English (C1). Our stack: Rust (plus some Python) on the backend, and TypeScript / Next.js on the frontend. The frontend is owned by our frontend engineers, so experience there is a plus but not required. How you work You communicate clearly and proactively. You’re comfortable talking to business colleagues, ask the right questions early, share progress without being asked and explain technical trade-offs in plain language. You value good engineering culture. We improve as a team, so honest feedback matters to us, and so do your ideas for improving our team culture, tools and the way we work in IT. You organize yourself. Give you a goal, and you’ll plan the work, set priorities and follow through, without needing a detailed ticket for every step. You’re genuinely curious. You enjoy digging into new topics, including the business side, and you keep learning as tools and AI evolve. You take ownership. You care about the outcome, not just the code, and you drive your topics forward instead of waiting for direction. If you match most of these points and want to help shape the technology behind one of Europe’s leading CSS providers, we’d love to hear from you. There’s no classic coding test in our process. Instead, we’ll talk through a realistic goal together and see how you approach it with AI. Apply now if you want stability without standing still: a place to learn, grow and stay. title: Marketing Lead B2B (a)
description: Role overview : The Marketing Lead (B2B) is pivotal in leading the development and execution of Oviva Germany' s Oviva’s B2B marketing strategy in Germany This role will directly drive awareness of Oviva's offering, deepen partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem, and generate qualified leads to support commercial growth You will build an MQL marketing funnel, own and optimize high-impact marketing channels, including Oviva’s Doctors’ Website, national and regional medical conferences, and doctor-facing communication assets. Beyond channel ownership, you will proactively identify new opportunities for strategic collaboration with physicians, institutions, and key industry stakeholders. Job requirements Essential: 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, HCP marketing or lead generation,, ideally within the German healthcare, international pharmaceutical or HealthTech/SaaS sectors. Proven track record of developing a B2B marketing function or inbound funnel Proven track record of managing a B2B website and executing multi-channel campaigns (Print, SEA). Highly analytical mindset: ROI attribution modelling, funnel KPI interpretation, data-driven channel optimisation. Strong writing and editing skills, with an ability to create content that resonates with a business audience/physicians. Strong project management: juggling multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously in a fast, pilot-driven environment. Language Qualification: Native-level German and professional fluency in English (C1). Desirable: Strong command of multi-channel HCP marketing: digital channels and traditional channels (print, fax/post, events) Experience working with Medical Affairs or Regulatory teams on compliant healthcare communications. Hands-on experience in conference organisation, including an eye for design. Familiarity with web analytics and design tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Canva, Figma). Job responsibilities Doctor Marketing Strategy & Positioning Lead the planning and execution of the German B2B marketing roadmap Develop segment specific activation strategies across the adoption funnel, ensuring alignment with national commercial milestones and OKRs. Be responsible for a unified narrative for Oviva’s physician engagement across all channels, aligning with brand guidelines and commercial priorities. Adapt global messaging to resonate with local healthcare professionals, ensuring cultural fit and regulatory alignment. Multi-channel Inbound Marketing & Lead Generation Manage and optimize digital paid and organic channels, including placements in medical publications (e.g., Ärzteblatt, doctor newsletters) and online performance marketing (SEA/LinkedIn) to generate MQLs Manage and optimize HCP community and traditional channels Partner with the CRM Manager to build automated nurture journeys Digital Asset Ownership (B2B Website) Take full ownership of the strategy, performance, and optimization of Oviva's B2B Doctors' Website incl content strategy, conversion, SEO, and user experience, acting as the primary lead for its growth and performance Continuously evaluate and refine the user journey for professional audiences, ensuring the website serves as a high converting entry point for the inbound engine. Manage the integration between web assets and CRM systems, ensuring seamless data flow and accurate tracking of the doctor engagement funnel. Coordinate with internal Product and Design teams (or external vendors) to implement website enhancements, maintaining Oviva’s high standards for brand excellence and accessibility. Sales Enablement Create and maintain sales toolkits (brochures, decks, case studies, digital kits) tailored for B2B health audiences. Conduct regular feedback loops with Sales and Field teams to ensure materials meet evolving BD and outreach needs. Co-develop commercial activation campaigns to accelerate deal cycles and support GP network growth. Strategic Events & Partnerships Develop and execute Oviva’s national and regional event roadmap to drive strategic growth and physician engagement. Identify, negotiate, and activate partnerships with healthcare bodies, KOLs, and conference platforms that align with commercial goals. Manage the event marketing budget to maximize brand impact and lead generation efficiency. Conduct post-event performance reviews to extract ROI insights and continuously refine BD engagement tactics. Innovation & Market Intelligence Maintain a deep understanding of the German healthcare landscape (including DiGA and SaaS trends) and competitor activities to ensure Oviva retains its market-leading position. Stay ahead of B2B growth trends, healthcare innovations, and physician marketing strategies relevant to Oviva’s mission. Translate B2B growth trends, competitor insights and market dynamics into strategic inputs for quarterly planning and BD roadmap development and test them applying test-learn-scale principles. Job benefits The opportunity to drive meaningful, life-changing impact through your work. A high-growth environment with strong development opportunities. Flexible working options – including remote working. Personal learning budget and development plans. A home working allowance to create your ideal workspace. Competitive salary (shared in the first screening call) and benefits Having a culture that people want to work in, is very important to us. We do this by keeping our values at the forefront of everything we do: We put the patient first. We empower our teams. We make it happen Oviva is passionate about creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diverse voices and perspectives. We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities. Ready to help shape the future of digital healthcare? Apply today. title: Security Engineer, Incident Response
description: Who we are At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Security Engineer, Incident Response About the job The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) is looking for a Security Engineer who is passionate about solving Twilio’s mission of security and reliability by working across the organization to lead the technical response to security events and incidents across Twilio’s global infrastructure, services and applications by effectively conducting triage, containment, remediation and driving post-incident betterments. You will work within a team that partners with R&D Engineering and R&D Business teams to develop scalable processes and technical solutions. You will be a valued member of a team of deeply technical Security Engineers to focus on creating bespoke and standard Security response processes, enhancing our capabilities for threat mitigation and incident response, and then automating as much as you possibly can (and more)! You will help us to grow our global, scaled team and program. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Lead and support the response to all security events and incidents across Twilio’s complex global infrastructure, services and applications. Be responsible for documentation of incidents and projects you work on and craft best practices as runbooks and standard operating procedures to share knowledge across teams. Work cross-collaboratively to understand and help solve challenges related to a broad spectrum of threat actors and activity. Work to improve Twilio’s security and reliability posture by driving identified betterments from security events and incidents. Rapidly acquire new technical skills and knowledge in a fast-paced, highly disruptive industry environment. Own the security incident lifecycle, respond to incidents and participate in on-call rotation and participate in RCAs for security incidents. Build, cultivate, and maintain positive relationships with internal customers to identify and facilitate solutions to increase the impact of the team’s work. Provide mentorship, support, and care for the team in a way that enables long-term career development, happiness, and success at scale. Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! Required: Proven experience: 3+ years of security incident response in a production-cloud environment Subject-matter expert on security issues and technologies Ability to utilize AI for comprehensive, complex security incident response activities delivering high fidelity detections Advanced knowledge of service-oriented architectures, as well as experience with security tools and technologies fit for a cloud environment Experience working across a technology stack on difficult security challenges and initiatives Experience with SIEM platforms and the ability to extend their functionality Experience with SOAR tools and automating manual security processes Experience in either AWS, GCP, or other large cloud platform Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with every level of the organization. Desired: AI Model Security & Posture Management: Support Implementation of controls and safeguards to prevent AI vulnerabilities, such as prompt injections, model evasion, and data poisoning AI-Driven Threat Response: Utilize GenAI and LLM-based security use cases to rapidly interpret alerts, reduce false positives, and contextualize threat data Artifact & Evidence Triage: Collects intrusion artifacts and forensically sound images to analyze malware, trojans, and source code. Threat Intelligence Integration: Monitors external vendor data and threat intelligence to analyze trends and proactively defend against emerging risks. Location This role will be remote, and based in Ireland or U.K. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. title: Senior Engineering Manager
description: We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers. Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work. Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission. You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our Progression Framework . Is this role right for you? While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles. We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at: Delivery and Execution : Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager. Engineering and Operational Excellence : Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key. People Leadership: Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback. Technical Influence: Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices. Stakeholder Relationships: Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work. Organisational Wide Impact: Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards. We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again. How we work : Locations & Flexible Working : Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨ Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays ️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online. Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life. At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. ✨ Work the way that works for you with Monzo! The interview process: After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’) Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below). The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are: - Team and Org Management (1 hour) An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had. - System Design (1 hour) You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise. - Behavioural (1 hour) Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager. - Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins) At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365. To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com Mattermost is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Technical Sales Engineer to join us as we enter the Japanese market. This is a high impact, early-stage opportunity requiring a player coach mentality with significant room for ownership, autonomy, and professional growth. As the first technical hire in Japan and the Indo Pacific region, you will lead technical demonstrations and serve as a strategic partner to our sales team, directly shaping regional growth and ensuring customer success in high trust environments. Mattermost is an open core technology company building secure collaboration solutions for organizations in high trust environments. We enable secure messaging and workflow automation across the world's most sensitive deployments, from air gapped defense systems to private clouds. In this role, you are the technical face of Mattermost in Japan, driving our expansion into one of our most critical growth regions. What You'll Do Lead all regional technical activities, including presales architecture, product demos, and deep dive technical evaluations Architect and deploy solutions within complex on premise, air gapped, and private cloud environments, ensuring operational resilience for defense and national security customers Collaborate with system integrators, VARs, and distributors to build a sustainable technical network and contribute to the regional partner go to market plan Translate complex technical details into value propositions for audiences ranging from executive C suite (General Officers) to frontline operational personnel Act as a bridge between Japanese customers and our global product and engineering teams, representing local requirements to help build world class, mission ready software Support technical engagements for key accounts to ensure customers are achieving their specific mission outcomes and workflow automation goals What We're Looking For Senior level technical experience, specifically within the cybersecurity sector or high growth SaaS/technology companies Proven experience serving defense, national security, or critical infrastructure customers Strong knowledge of closed cloud environments, on premise deployments, and the technical and operational concepts utilized within secure sectors Independent, creative problem solver capable of negotiating technical win win scenarios; experience in global startups is preferred Native Japanese language skills and strong English proficiency (reading/writing) Ability to travel based on business needs to support partner events, tradeshows, and customer sites (up to 50%) Nice to Have Active security clearance, highly desired due to the nature of our mission critical customer base Awareness of GenAI and its applications in secure collaboration Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent work experience How Success Is Measured Quota attainment: consistent achievement of enterprise ACV and ARR targets. Pipeline generation: self-sourced pipeline as a percentage of total pipeline created. Deal quality: average deal size, sales cycle length, and win rate across enterprise accounts. Executive engagement: multi-threaded relationships and documented executive alignment in target accounts. Cross-functional feedback: positive collaboration scores from Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Product partners. AI-forward environment: We actively adopt and build AI-enabled workflows — you’ll have access to cutting-edge tooling to accelerate your productivity. Open source at the core: Be part of a vibrant community shaping the future of secure collaboration. High-growth opportunity: Strong momentum in the defense and enterprise markets, with meaningful equity upside as we scale toward our revenue goals. Technical understanding of core communications protocols and standards (e.g., SMPP, SIP, REST APIs, A2P/P2P messaging). title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Contract
description: Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you'll be a key part of our TA team, contributing to how we find and attract talent at Toast. You'll manage the full recruitment process, focusing on building strong candidate pools, making sure candidates have a great experience, and adapting to different hiring needs. Toast's Talent Acquisition team prioritizes collaboration, expertise, and strong connections with our business partners. We're dedicated to finding the best candidates to support the growth of our company. If you're a recruiter with a passion for finding top talent and a proven track record of success in complex high volume recruiting, we'd love to hear from you. Note : this is a fully remote, contract position based in Australia (Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane). A day in the life (Responsibilities) Deliver on recruiting goals and prioritise workload to meet deadlines and evolving business needs. Attract, source, recruit, and engage top talent for Toast’s GTM functions, predominantly Sales. Proactively build and maintain strong talent pipelines through strategic sourcing, leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, referrals, professional networks, and creative outreach strategies to identify and engage passive candidates. Own end-to-end sourcing strategies for assigned roles, including market research, competitor mapping, targeted outreach, and nurturing relationships with prospective candidates to support current and future hiring needs. Exercise sound judgment and decision-making throughout the recruitment process, balancing business needs with candidate experience. Skillfully navigate complex and ambiguous hiring scenarios, partnering with hiring managers to clarify requirements, align expectations, and drive decision-making. Build strong relationships with hiring managers through regular recruiting syncs, effective communication, and subject matter expertise. Develop creative sourcing and recruitment solutions, adapting strategies to address talent shortages, competitive market conditions, and changing business priorities. Leverage sourcing data, pipeline conversion rates, and key recruitment metrics to evaluate effectiveness, optimise strategies, and deliver efficient and impactful hiring outcomes. Provide exceptional service to candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a positive and memorable experience throughout the recruitment process. Share ideas, provide updates, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve recruitment practices. Demonstrated depth and breadth of experience in high-volume recruiting, successfully partnering with hiring managers to fill roles across various GTM functions. Proficiency in leveraging recruitment data and metrics to impact hiring decisions. Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively. Proven ability to work in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, with strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset. title: Senior Manager, Field Readiness
description: Reports to: VP, Sales Enablement About Axiom Axiom, a leading global marketplace for on-demand legal talent, is leading a revolution in the legal industry. The Axiom model disrupts the traditional allocation of work to law firms and in-house teams. By matching highly credentialed lawyers and legal talent with legal work across industries and practice areas, Axiom enables clients to become more agile and efficient and empowers lawyers and legal talent to pursue more of the work they love. Axiom serves over half the Fortune 100 with market leading NPS ratings from both its clients and employees. Role Summary improving seller execution and accelerating readiness across designated segments of the business. Embedded closely with the field, this person will develop a deep understanding of business priorities, performance trends, customer dynamics, and the day-to-day realities of our sellers. They will identify where execution is breaking down, uncover emerging risks and opportunities, and translate those insights into practical, targeted enablement solutions. This role serves as both an extension of Enablement into the field and the voice of the field back into Enablement—ensuring our programs, tools, messaging, and learning experiences are relevant, actionable, and connected to the needs of the business. This is a hands-on role. The Senior Manager, Field Readiness will diagnose needs, architect solutions, build content and learning experiences, facilitate programs, and measure whether those interventions are changing behavior and improving execution. What You’ll Do Partner with the Field Build strong partnerships with sales leaders, frontline managers, sellers, and cross-functional partners within assigned segments. Develop a deep understanding of segment priorities, customer dynamics, seller workflows, performance expectations, and business challenges. Maintain a regular presence with the field to understand what sellers and managers are experiencing in their day-to-day work. Serve as a trusted enablement partner to sales leadership, bringing both a field perspective and an objective view of performance opportunities. Diagnose Performance & Readiness Needs Use field observation, performance data, call intelligence, manager input, seller feedback, and other available insights to identify execution gaps, risks, and opportunities. Look beyond requests for “training” to diagnose the underlying behavior, skill, knowledge, process, messaging, or adoption issue. Identify patterns across teams and translate field observations into clear, actionable enablement priorities. Establish an ongoing field-insight cadence, bringing emerging themes and needs back to the broader Enablement organization. Design & Build Enablement Solutions Translate business and field needs into practical enablement interventions designed to improve seller behavior and performance. Design end-to-end learning journeys that combine live learning, self-paced content, practice, reinforcement, manager involvement, and point-of-need performance support. Develop bespoke programs and workshops to address the specific needs of assigned sales segments. Tailor global enablement programs, messaging, tools, and resources to ensure they are relevant and applicable to individual segments and teams. Build high-quality facilitator-led and digital learning experiences, including workshops, e-learning modules, job aids, playbooks, practice activities, and other performance-support resources. Apply adult-learning and instructional-design principles to create practical learning experiences tied to specific seller behaviors and business outcomes. Facilitate & Activate Facilitate engaging, highly practical learning experiences for sellers and sales leaders. Create opportunities for sellers to practice new skills and apply learning to real customer situations. Partner with frontline managers to reinforce learning and drive sustained behavior change following formal enablement. Support the activation of global programs within assigned segments, adapting delivery and reinforcement based on field needs. Leverage Learning Technology Build and maintain digital learning and courseware using tools such as Articulate 360, Storyline, Rise, or comparable authoring platforms. Leverage learning management systems and enablement technologies to deploy, manage, track, and continuously improve learning experiences. Help establish scalable approaches to digital learning, curriculum development, and learning journeys as Axiom continues to expand its enablement capabilities. Collaborate Across the Business Partner effectively across Sales, Marketing, Sales Operations, Product, and other functions to bring the right expertise and resources to field challenges. Translate broader commercial initiatives into practical implications for sellers and managers. Connect global programs with field realities, helping ensure enablement investments translate into execution. Measure & Improve Define intended behaviors and outcomes for enablement interventions. Measure adoption, application, and impact using quantitative and qualitative data. Gather feedback from sellers and leaders and use those insights to continuously improve programs. Share field insights and program results with Enablement and sales leadership to inform future priorities. What We’re Looking For 6+ years of progressive sales enablement experience, ideally including significant experience in a field-facing enablement, sales readiness, or performance-consulting role. Demonstrated ability to diagnose performance and execution gaps and translate them into practical solutions. Strong instructional-design and curriculum-development capability across instructor-led, virtual, workshop-based, blended, and self-paced learning. Hands-on experience building digital learning and courseware using Articulate 360, Storyline, Rise, or comparable authoring tools. Experience working with learning management systems and other learning or sales enablement technologies. Excellent facilitation skills and demonstrated credibility working directly with sellers and sales leaders. Strong business acumen and an ability to quickly understand the realities of a seller’s day-to-day work. Experience using qualitative and quantitative insights—including sales performance data, call intelligence, field observation, and stakeholder input—to inform enablement priorities. Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, prioritize competing needs, and move quickly from problem identification to action. Resourceful, pragmatic, and comfortable building high-quality solutions without requiring extensive infrastructure or lengthy development cycles. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Experience Previous quota-carrying sales experience is highly desirable. Experience supporting complex, consultative, or intangible sales environments. Experience supporting professional services or other services-based sales organizations is particularly valuable. Experience partnering directly with frontline sales managers to drive coaching, reinforcement, and behavior change. Experience building or evolving enablement capabilities, systems, or processes in a growing organization. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means having a deep understanding of the field—not simply responding to requests for training. You will know where execution is breaking down, understand why it is happening, and be able to recommend the right intervention. You will be equally comfortable analyzing the business, listening to customer calls, partnering with sales leaders, designing a learning journey, building the content, facilitating a workshop, and assessing whether behavior changed as a result. Ultimately, you will help create a continuous connection between what our sellers need, what the business needs, and how Enablement helps close the gap. Axiom’s total rewards philosophy is to be transparent and equitable with all job candidates. The salary range for this Senior Manager-level U.S.-based remote role is $180,000–$222,000 OTE. You can also participate in our benefits programs, which include healthcare, life and disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, paid sick and personal time off, paid parental leave, and more. Please note that final compensation is determined by several considerations, including the quality of your experience and expertise, your ability to immediately contribute to Axiom, your potential to progress to the next level, the market in which you are located, and other business considerations. Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities: Upon request and consistent with applicable laws, Axiom will attempt to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities who require an accommodation to participate in the application process. To request an accommodation to complete the application form, please contact us at benefits@axiomlaw.com and include “Applicant Accommodation” in the subject line. #LI-NS2

title: Senior Manager, Enablement Learning Experience

This is not a traditional instructional design role. We are looking for an experienced enablement professional who is also an exceptional builder—someone who understands sales, knows how adults learn, and can translate complex ideas into simple, engaging experiences that help sellers and leaders perform differently. This person will serve as a shared learning-experience resource across Enablement, partnering with Global Programs, Field Readiness, and other members of the team to architect and build scalable learning solutions. The role will have particular responsibility for expanding our self-paced and digital learning capabilities while also contributing to live workshops, blended learning journeys, presentations, video, and performance-support resources. The right person is equally comfortable meeting with a senior subject-matter expert, defining learning objectives, developing a learning architecture, building an e-learning experience, editing video, or creating a polished executive-quality PowerPoint deck. What You’ll Do Build High-Impact Learning Experiences Design and develop engaging self-paced learning experiences that translate complex concepts into practical, actionable learning. Build digital learning using tools such as Articulate 360, Storyline, Rise, or comparable authoring platforms. Create and edit video, audio, graphics, presentations, and other multimedia components to support modern learning experiences. Develop highly polished PowerPoint presentations and facilitator materials for live and virtual enablement. Build supporting resources including job aids, practice activities, assessments, reinforcement, and point-of-need performance support. Ensure learning experiences are practical, engaging, concise, and grounded in the realities of the sales environment. Architect Learning Journeys Partner with Enablement leaders to translate business priorities into effective learning strategies and experiences. Define clear learning and behavioral objectives tied to the outcomes a program is intended to achieve. Help architect blended learning journeys incorporating self-paced learning, live workshops, practice, application, reinforcement, manager involvement, and performance support. Recommend the right learning modality based on the audience, desired behavior change, business need, and complexity of the content. Apply adult-learning and learning-experience-design principles without over-engineering solutions. Partner with Subject-Matter Experts Work directly with subject-matter experts across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Legal, and other functions to extract expertise and translate it into compelling learning. Lead structured working sessions with SMEs to identify what learners truly need to know and do. Simplify complex or highly technical material without losing its substance. Provide thoughtful recommendations and challenge content when necessary to keep learning focused on the intended audience and business outcome. Build credibility with senior stakeholders and independently manage the content-development process from discovery through delivery. Serve as a Shared Enablement Resource Partner closely with Global Programs, Field Readiness, and other Enablement functions to bring programs and initiatives to life. Provide learning-experience expertise across multiple concurrent enablement initiatives. Establish repeatable templates, standards, and approaches that improve the quality and consistency of Enablement deliverables. Help the broader Enablement team determine when to build, reuse, adapt, or simplify learning solutions. Create scalable assets that can be adapted across segments, audiences, and programs. Leverage Enablement & Learning Technology Build, publish, manage, and maintain learning experiences within Seismic and other learning and enablement platforms. Leverage LMS functionality to organize curricula and learning journeys, manage assignments, and track completion and engagement. Help establish scalable standards for digital learning development, publishing, maintenance, and governance. Evaluate emerging learning technologies and capabilities and identify practical opportunities to improve the learner experience and increase development efficiency. Manage the Work Manage multiple projects simultaneously across different programs, stakeholders, and deadlines. Establish clear development plans, milestones, dependencies, and review cycles. Balance speed and quality, recognizing when an asset requires significant production and when a simpler solution will achieve the desired outcome. Maintain and update learning assets as programs, messaging, processes, and business priorities evolve. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or a closely related enablement function. Demonstrated experience personally building enablement programs and learning experiences—not simply managing external vendors or instructional designers. Strong hands-on expertise with digital learning authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Storyline, Rise, or equivalent. Experience creating and editing video and multimedia learning content. Advanced PowerPoint skills and a strong eye for information design, visual storytelling, and presentation quality. Experience working with learning management systems and sales enablement platforms; Seismic experience is highly desirable. Strong understanding of adult learning, learning-experience design, curriculum development, and blended-learning principles. Demonstrated ability to establish clear learning objectives and translate them into practical learning experiences and assessments. Experience working directly with subject-matter experts and senior stakeholders to develop content. Strong understanding of sales environments and the needs of sellers and sales leaders. Excellent written communication, editing, and content-simplification skills. Strong project-management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
